note: Merger/acquisition tracker — symbols that have merged, been acquired, or changed trading status. When a merger completes, remove the absorbed symbol from universe.json and delete its stock page.
watchlist: Monitor NEPSE announcements, ShareSansar, and company notices for merger/acquisition MOUs, SGM approvals, and trading halts.

stages.description: Merger MOU/news announced. Both symbols still trade independently.
Submitted for regulatory approval (SEBON/NRB). SGM approvals. Both symbols still trade.
Trading halted for a few days during the merger execution.
Trading resumes as merged entity — either with new name/symbol, or old name/symbol representing the combined entity. Absorbed symbol removed.

actions_per_stage.announced: Log in tracker. Monitor for progress. No data changes.
actions_per_stage.in_process: Update tracker. Flag for close monitoring. No data changes yet.
actions_per_stage.halted: Note halt in tracker. Pages remain but show halt status if possible.
actions_per_stage.completed: Remove absorbed symbol from universe.json. Delete its stock page. Remove from sitemap. Update survivor's share data.
